bound-design-system-structural-prompts.principle: When passing the bound Stitch design system asset, keep generation prompts strictly structural and omit raw hex codes, font names, or radius values; reserve exact hex codes for targeted edit_screens calls only.

stitch-upload-and-artifact-checkpoints.principle: Require explicit user confirmation before uploading local HTML/images/DESIGN.md to Stitch, overwriting existing .stitch/designs/ assets, or running automated snapshot capture against a local dev server.

stitch-metadata-and-fullres-visual-audit.principle: Download generated HTML and full-resolution screenshots (=w{width}) via shell/curl into .stitch/designs/, inspect each PNG before coding, and persist screen IDs and sync timestamps in .stitch/metadata.json.

stitch-python-uploader-for-large-files.principle: Upload files larger than 5 KB (including .stitch/DESIGN.md and extracted HTML/images) via upload_to_stitch.py reading STITCH_API_KEY from the environment instead of inline MCP base64 arguments or --api-key CLI flags.

no-dead-stitch-anchors-or-fabricated-met.principle: Replace all Stitch placeholder anchors (href='#') with real routes or handlers, never fabricate metrics/SLAs or unobserved design tokens, and omit filler UI copy.

touch-target-and-responsive-bounds.principle: Enforce minimum 44-48px touch targets and zero horizontal overflow on mobile viewports.
